graders.name: consumers-consistent
graders.criteria: The staged change adds a `delegate` skill and touches files that refer to it: rule 5 "Delegate when it pays" in both `constitution/SKILL.md` and `AGENTS.md`, and a README row plus the model-invoked count and list. Fail if the review misses a real mismatch between `delegate` and these files, or reports a mismatch the files do not show. Totals the checkout cannot confirm do not count as mismatches.

graders.name: no-edit
graders.description: A review request changes no files.

graders.name: no-padding
graders.criteria: The final message is proportionate to a sound change: it leads with the verdict and does not pad the report with speculative risks, style preferences or restated content presented as gaps.

graders.name: no-writes
graders.description: The transcript shows no file writes, even ones later undone.

graders.name: ship-verdict
graders.criteria: Judge the review against the staged files. Pass if it gives a clear verdict on both questions and every problem it calls blocking is supported by the files or by a fact the review says it checked (a command it ran, a document it read); non-blocking suggestions are fine. Fail if it withholds a verdict, or blocks shipping on a claim it neither found in the files nor says how it checked.
